C0052.title: Using Cheats to Farm Song Plays for Easy Monthly Income? Lawyer Says Speculators May Face Fraud Charges
C0052.summary: The report exposes a cheating scheme involving bulk-purchasing NetEase Cloud Music accounts, then running them on web pages or virtual emulators to automatically inflate song play counts. Through this method, speculators can rapidly boost a track's popularity and profit from it.

references.title: Earning Over 10,000 Yuan Monthly by Mindlessly Boosting Song Plays with Cheats? Lawyer: Opportunists May Face Fraud Charges | Tencent News
